purpose: Combat and kill-feed screening only; native balance/win rates remain unverified.
assumptions: Native Castle-wave unit IDs, damage/armour classes, speed, range, projectiles, abilities and counters remain intact.
Flat HP additions improve fragile-body durability; replacement/cap decisions preserve distinct army roles.
Per-kill hero progression is unchanged; death feeding is a design consideration rather than a new score ledger.
Overall four-Castle maximum birth frequency remains within five percent of v0.10.0.
Native half-population storage is measured; resource40 military-cap weighting is tested as both body and weighted-cap sensitivity, not asserted.
Paired deterministic screening is a stress test; it omits full native AI, kiting, terrain, aura/special mechanics and later researched upgrades.
No engine playback, multiplayer delivery or equal-win-rate claim follows from automated checks.
Native military-cap accounting is unverified; body/population bases are separate sensitivities.
Fresh starts contain no ordinary units; replacements approximate four-Castle waves.
Paired rounds equalize lineup positions; opponent coverage and human micro are not exhaustive.
Deaths feed equal native kills; the screen does not change progression or add a kill ledger.
